title: BAST/4/2010 of SULEMAN ALIAS IMRAN Vs STATE OF UTTARAKHAND

paras.text:
IN THEHIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND AT NAINITAL
ORIGINAL JURISDICTION
Dated: Nainital: the 13th day of April, 2010
Ist Short Term Bail Application No. 4 of 2010
Order on the Bail application of accused.
CRIMINAL SIDE
Suleman @ Imran .....Applicant (In jail)
Versus
State of Uttarakhand ...... Opposite Party
Arising out of Case Crime No. 231/2009,
U/s 304B IPC,
PS Kotwali Roorkee, District Haridwar.
April 13, 2010
HON'BLE DHARAM VEER,J.
Heard Mr. KS Verma, Advocate for the applicant and Mr.
Amit Bhatt, Addl. GA for the State.
Report dated 31.3.2010 of the Superintendent, Sub-Jail,
Roorkee reveals that the accused applicant was sent for the
treatment in the AIIMS, New Delhi and after treatment from
the AIIMS, New Delhi he came back in the jail on 14.10.2009
and thereafter on the same day i.e. on 14.10.2009 he was sent
to the Civil Hospital, Roorkee for the treatment where he was
admitted and discharged from the hospital on 25.11.2009 as
per the medical advice. Thereafter he was admitted in the jail
hospital of Roorkee for the treatment and he has regularly
been treated in the jail hospital. It is further stated in the
report that the applicant was also sent to AIIMS, New Delhi on
20.9.2009, where he was operated and discharged from the
hospital after the treatment as per the medical advice on
13.10.2009.
Thus, the aforesaid report reveals that the jail
authorities are taking proper care of the accused applicant
and he was given treatment in the best hospital of the country
in the AIIMS, New Delhi and he was treated there as per the
medical advice.
As all the medical facilities are available to the accused
applicant in the jail, therefore, there is no ground to release
the applicant on parole.
The short term bail application is rejected accordingly.
However, Superintendent, Sub-Jail, Roorkee is directed that if

2
as per the medical advice, treatment is not possible in Roorkee
Hospital, then the applicant may be sent to other hospitals for
further treatment as per the medical advice.
(Dharam Veer, J.)
13.4.2010
PRABODH
